title: Boring Boring
text: This is too easy to solve. All you have to do is look at the time stamp and boom you can eliminate the monthly suspect. No need to read any of the clues just look for time stamped document.  So far all 5 boxes have been solved on the time stamp.  We even sit around trying to make something out of nothing to try to feel like we are getting our moneys worth. Time stamps people. Too expensive.  I think these should be real cold case files. now that would be fun.
label: negative
